findings.reason: as written the node repairs the shared read and silently removes an intentional validation failure from dispatch and review, a wider behaviour change than the one id's contract and one the section's own done-when cannot detect; naming the review-brief read as the repair site confines it.
findings.text: §59 says "The repair is at that read" of `_domain_config` in `reckon/crew/domain_rules.py`, but that function is the one shared read behind `rules_for` and `declares_review_checks`, and its own docstring declares the opposite contract: "a block the schema rejects raises from here, which is the loud failure the module exists to give", while `rules_for` says "a field the schema renames fails here rather than silently matching nothing" — so falling back there makes a malformed `domain` block silently yield no domain rules for dispatch admission (`reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py:2153 _node_domain_rules`, which composes every dispatch brief's rules) and for review (`reckon/crew/review.py:628 declares_review_checks`) as well as the promotion brief — the promotion gate's own read says so at `reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1230`, "cannot be read raises rather than promoting a node whose rules were never matched" — and no test in the section's gate would notice because the loud-failure tests pin `flight.resolve` directly (`tests/test_domain_rules.py:88,106`) rather than the shared read — while the narrower site, `domain_review_checks`/`_declared_check_block` in `reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py`, is already inside §59's write paths and satisfies the same id

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every file §59 names exists (`promotion_checks.py`, `promotion_gate.py`, `domain_rules.py`, `recovery_review_subject.py`, the cited test), the cited commit `a5cedef37` resolves to "feat(promotion): replay a repository's declared invariant checks at promotion", and the failure route the section states is the one the snapshot reproduces.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §59 names one id, a base arm from `git archive` extractions, a revert-the-repair negative control, and log and ruff clauses, so the measure can fail.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §59 requires every log under the run directory, which is durable, and names no scratchpad or node-local path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the title and body name the mechanism (an unreadable light ceiling falling back to the shipped one) and carry no plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the root cause matches the reproduction exactly, but the repair site §59 names (`_domain_config`) is contradicted by the docstring of the very read it cites and by a second production caller (dispatch admission).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §59 carries one deliverable, the fallback at the promotion's domain-config read, for one id.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §59's prose sequences it after §51, and the shared write path on `reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py` is protected by dispatch's claim check rather than a declared depends-on, as the earlier decision on §53 accepted; the plan's only declared section edges (`s32`, `s60`) resolve.
